snippet.title: Shoot The Zombirds by iDreams -World Premiere Trailer
snippet.description:
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pl.idreams.ShootTheZombirds
Dive into new and absorbing game of bird and zombie shooting. Official game trailer presents powerups, challenging objectives and amazing graphics. Game can be downloaded from Google Play and Apple App Store:
iTunes link: http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/shoot-the-zombirds/id497933996

More info at: www.idreams.pl

Please remember to thumbs up if you like this video and follow Infinite Dreams on facebook & twitter for news, giveaways and more fun stuff!
